Device Fabrication and Characterizations : The fluorine doped tin oxide (FTO) conducting glass substrates were first cleaned in an ultrasonic cleaner using detergent, deionized water, acetone, and isopropanol www.solar-rrl.com sequentially for 15 min each. The cleaned substrates were then treated with ultraviolet ozone (UV-ozone) for 15 min and transferred to a glovebox. The solutions of SIM (1 mg mL � 1 ) and DIM (1 mg mL � 1 ) were prepared using anhydrous chlorobenzene solvents inside the N2-filled glovebox. The solutions were spin coated on the FTO substrates at a rate of 3000 rpm for 30 s and then were annealed at 100 °C for 10 min.
